name: SINOTECH Company Limited
summary: SINOTECH Company Limited specializes in the development, production, and marketing of catalytic converters aimed at environmental protection. Its diverse product line features solutions for treating exhaust gases from automobiles, sophisticated catalyst systems for off-road mobile equipment emissions, marine vessel exhaust catalysts, and industrial catalysts designed to purify volatile organic compounds. This company was established on July 15, 2005, and operates from its primary office in Chengdu, China.
